evals.prompt: Create repository knowledge docs for the fixture repo in evals/files/create-basic. Keep the output compact and evidence-backed.
evals.expected_output: A minimal knowledge set that creates only documents whose value tests pass, uses source and manifest evidence for current-state claims, and reports unknowns instead of guessing.
assertions: Created documents satisfy the document-contract value tests instead of creating placeholders
CONTEXT.md is not created when candidate terms are safely recoverable from obvious source and test names
Runnable commands are traced to package.json scripts before publication
Domain and source-navigation facts cite behavior-bearing source or focused tests
The final report includes mode, changed files, decisive evidence, unknowns, and checks when applicable

evals.prompt: Refresh the existing knowledge docs in evals/files/refresh-stale after source paths changed. Preserve supported human-authored guidance and correct stale current-state claims.
evals.expected_output: A refresh that limits changes to affected stale facts, keeps supported local guidance, corrects stale paths, verifies and retains current commands from repository evidence, and reports the baseline or lack of reliable baseline.
assertions: Supported human-authored guidance remains intact
Stale paths are corrected or removed only after checking current repository evidence
The diff avoids unrelated wording, ordering, or formatting churn
The report identifies the refresh baseline used or states that no reliable baseline existed

evals.prompt: Perform a CODE-MAP-only refresh for evals/files/code-map-only so navigation points match the current source tree. Leave all other knowledge documents unchanged.
evals.expected_output: Only CODE-MAP.md changes; AGENTS.md and ARCHITECTURE.md remain byte-for-byte unchanged while stale navigation entries are updated from source evidence.
assertions: No knowledge document except CODE-MAP.md is modified
Every retained CODE-MAP.md link resolves with exact path case
The report explicitly confirms CODE-MAP-only isolation was checked

evals.prompt: Refresh architecture knowledge for evals/files/conflicted-intent. Existing docs describe a target event stream, but current source implements synchronous HTTP calls.
evals.expected_output: Current behavior is documented from source evidence, contradicted target architecture remains only as labelled unresolved intent, and the conflict is reported as a stale or unresolved claim.
assertions: Current-state architecture claims prefer behavior-bearing source over prose
Contradicted human-authored intent is preserved only when labelled as unresolved intent
The report names the implementation conflict and what evidence would resolve it
No equal-authority conflict is resolved by guessing

evals.prompt: Create repository knowledge docs for evals/files/insufficient-evidence.
evals.expected_output: No knowledge documents are created because the fixture lacks a manifest, entry point, build or executable script, and behavior-bearing source file. The report states the insufficient evidence gate and the inspected scope.
assertions: No AGENTS.md, CONTEXT.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, or CODE-MAP.md placeholder is created
The report names the missing repository signals and the inspected scope

evals.prompt: Refresh the knowledge docs in evals/files/duplicate-facts. The duplicated test command should have one durable owner.
evals.expected_output: The runnable test command remains owned by AGENTS.md, the duplicate command is removed or replaced with an owner link outside AGENTS.md, and the consolidation is reported.
assertions: Runnable commands follow the document ownership table
The duplicated durable command fact has a single owner after refresh
The report includes a consolidation entry naming the affected fact
Current-state source facts remain backed by source or focused tests

evals.prompt: Refresh repository knowledge for evals/files/nested-inventory. Preserve nested agent guidance and ADR rationale that still match current source evidence.
evals.expected_output: The inventory includes the root guide, nested service guide, and ADR. Materially different nested guidance is retained, ADR rationale is linked or preserved as the decision owner, and source-navigation facts point to current files.
assertions: Nested guidance with materially different completion checks is retained
ADR rationale remains owned by the ADR instead of being duplicated into ARCHITECTURE.md
Stale CODE-MAP.md paths are corrected from current source evidence

evals.prompt: Create a dedicated coding-agent knowledge base for the checkout functional module in evals/files/module-knowledge. Keep repository-wide and unrelated profile knowledge with their existing owners.
evals.expected_output: A module knowledge set rooted at docs/project-knowledge/modules/checkout with MODULE.md as its entry, only value-tested supporting documents, and one minimal discovery pointer while unrelated root knowledge and product source remain unchanged.
assertions: MODULE.md identifies checkout from its registered trigger, orchestration, observable result, and focused test rather than treating one directory as the boundary
Inventory and payment behavior is recorded as dependency boundary evidence without inventing ownership or absorbing their independent behavior into checkout
Only supporting documents whose module-scoped value tests pass are created
The existing AGENTS.md guidance is preserved and receives exactly one resolving conditional discovery pointer; any added module command or check is backed by package.json
The unrelated root ARCHITECTURE.md, profile source, and all product source files remain unchanged
Every module knowledge link resolves with exact path case

evals.prompt: Create a dedicated coding-agent knowledge base for the returns functional module in evals/files/module-knowledge.
evals.expected_output: No returns module knowledge is created because returns exists only as planned prose and lacks a reachable trigger, behavior-bearing implementation, and observable outcome; checkout evidence does not satisfy the returns sufficiency gate.
assertions: The functional-module sufficiency gate is applied to returns rather than to the repository as a whole
Planned prose is classified as intent and does not prove current module behavior
No returns MODULE.md, supporting knowledge document, or AGENTS.md pointer is created

Stale module paths are corrected by tracing the current route registration through orchestration and its focused test
Supported human-authored separation guidance remains intact
Root ARCHITECTURE.md and CODE-MAP.md remain byte-for-byte unchanged
The AGENTS.md discovery pointer remains unchanged when it already resolves
The diff contains no product-source or unrelated knowledge changes

evals.prompt: Create only a CODE-MAP.md for the checkout functional module in evals/files/module-knowledge. Leave every other knowledge document unchanged.

AGENTS.md, root ARCHITECTURE.md, MODULE.md, and every other knowledge document remain byte-for-byte unchanged
The code map links the registered trigger, controlling orchestration, dependency edges, and focused test with exact path case

evals.prompt: Create a dedicated coding-agent knowledge base for the Checkout functional module in evals/files/module-context. Follow the repository's existing knowledge index and preserve repository-level ownership.
evals.expected_output: The Checkout module set includes a value-tested CONTEXT.md for its distinct meaning of hold; the declared project knowledge index gets one module pointer, the root CONTEXT-MAP.md gets only the required Checkout context entry and relationship, and AGENTS.md remains unchanged.

AGENTS.md remains byte-for-byte unchanged because it already points to the declared knowledge index

The root CONTEXT-MAP.md receives only the Checkout context index and conflicting-term relationship required by its owner contract
The existing Accounts glossary, domain evidence, product source, and tests remain unchanged
Every new or modified local Markdown link resolves with exact path case

evals.prompt: Create a dedicated coding-agent knowledge base for the guild leaderboard functional module in evals/files/module-discovery-only. Use the temporary delivery summary as a discovery source, but the final knowledge must remain self-contained after that file is deleted and must not name or link it.
evals.expected_output: A module knowledge set that independently verifies current behavior, transfers only durable compatible rationale, treats external state as a prerequisite or unknown, and exposes production runtime-boundary gaps hidden by hand-built test doubles.
assertions: No created or modified knowledge file names, links, cites, or directs readers to the temporary delivery summary, and all knowledge remains understandable with that input removed

The declared composition root and concrete store independently prove that consecutive positive writes report cumulative totals; the stale 500 threshold and planned monthly board are not published as current behavior

Maximum-score retention is treated as repository-unverifiable external state, while compatible convergence and region-migration rationale is transferred without using the temporary input as proof of behavior

The region-migration owner passage traces its reachable caller and does not claim externally observed report-before-delete ordering: in that flow, rather than only in a shared transport summary, it distinguishes queued report from direct delete, local invocation from remote application, and the stubbed call-order test from production transport behavior

The member-score read contract is reported as currently defective: the reachable composed path hydrates a Map that the consumer reads with object property access and Object.keys, producing zero scores and missing departed contributors despite the passing plain-object unit fixture

The maintenance-refresh owner passage preserves the delete and report completion layers and fallbacks rather than relying on a shared transport summary, and describes the operation as best-effort because its composed path can return a score after delete failure is swallowed and report is only queued

Only value-tested module documents, one minimal discovery pointer, and evidenced module commands or checks change; root architecture, root code map, product source, tests, and the temporary input remain unchanged
